texts.en:
Welcome! [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] offers state of the art security services to our customers. We have civil contracts across multiple worlds, ranging from personal security details to training drills for enforcers.

But for our high profile clients, we aim to provide the best of the best. Fleets, armies, military advisors... A range of peacekeeping options is available. For a modest fee of course.

texts.zh:
啊，战争贩子回来了。

你终于想清楚你这些毫无意义的行为是徒劳的了吗？这是一点小意思，谨表对你善意的回馈，我们[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]愿意将这些分歧暂时搁置。让我们一起期待一个有利可图的未来。
texts.en:
Ah, the warmonger returns.

Have you finally come to your senses and seen the futility of these pointless actions of yours? For a small sum, a mere token of your goodwill, we at the [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] are willing to put these disagreements aside. Together, let us look forward to a profitable future.

label.en: So be it.

notes.zh: 审阅注：首次接触完成或“通讯已建立”后经enclave.204打开，之后每次外交联络经enclave.200打开；玩家亲手建立佣兵城邦后也会立即打开（enclave.21）。各项服务返回本菜单，是可重复的服务枢纽。处于敌对时只显示“花2500能量和解”。
notes.en: Review note: opened via enclave.204 after first contact or 'Communications Established', via enclave.200 on every later diplomatic contact, and right after the player founds a mercenary enclave (enclave.21). Services return here: a repeatable hub. While hostile only the 2500-energy truce option is shown.

texts.zh:
棒极了！招募一支[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]舰队永远是正确的选择。我们的部队绝对是星系中最训练有素、纪律严明的，而我们的科技也处于绝对尖端。海盗、叛军或者其他需要你处理的乌合之众会很快学会什么叫尊重。

此外，我们的每一支舰队都由一位身经百战的舰队指挥官，这是不需要额外付费的。他们知悉星际战争的方方面面，一定可以带领你的军队走向胜利。
texts.en:
Excellent! Recruiting a [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] fleet is always the right choice. Our forces are amongst the best-trained and most disciplined in the galaxy, and our tech is cutting edge. Pirates, insurgents, and any other rabble you might have recourse to deal with will soon learn to show respect.

 Additionally, each of our fleets comes with a battle-proven Commander at no extra charge. Adept in all facets of interstellar warfare, they will surely lead your forces to victory.

label.en: We'd like to discuss another matter.
It's a deal!

tooltips.zh: 评价：£opinion£ +15
tooltips.en: Opinion: £opinion£ +15

label.en: Goodbye.

notes.zh: 审阅注：租约10年。到期时由独立故事“舰队合约到期”通知；若城邦遭受攻击，租用方会收到“舰队紧急召回”。
notes.en: Review note: the lease runs 10 years. Expiry is announced by the separate story 'Fleet Contract Ended'; if the enclave is attacked, the client receives 'Emergency Fleet Recall'.

texts.zh: 我相信你一定会运用好你的新部队，而和平将很快回到你的帝国！
texts.en: I trust that you will put your new troops to excellent use, and that peace will soon return to your empire!

label.en: So be it.

texts.zh: 你是想终止还是延长合同？我们得先准备必要的文件。目前我方正在开展一项促销活动，续签合同的客户将收到一箱免费手榴弹作为赠礼！
texts.en: Do you wish to terminate or prolong a contract? Let us prepare the necessary documents. We are currently running a promotion where customers receive a complimentary crate of grenades for every renewed contract!

label.en: We'd like to discuss another matter.
We wish to extend our contract.

Goodbye.

texts.zh:
我们的驻防部队能够表现出非凡的价值，但是请牢记，在[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]我们避讳用“雇佣军”这个词称呼他们。这个词太直白，带有太多的负面联想。我们的“国防承包商”已经准备好对你的空间站进行布置，以迎接这些“安全专家”。在我们就绪后，这些专家将开始训练空间站的成员，以使他们发挥自己最好的水平。

在[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]，我们只专心训练最杰出的和平卫士。
texts.en:
Our garrisons offer exceptional value. However, please keep in mind that at [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] we frown upon the term 'mercenary.' The word is too blunt, and carries far too many negative associations. Our 'defense contractors' are standing by to prepare your station for the arrival of our 'safety specialists.' Once we're on site, these specialists will begin drilling the station crew to bring out their best. 

 At [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] we aim to train only the finest peacekeepers.

label.en: We'd like to discuss another matter.
It's a deal!

tooltips.zh: 评价：£opinion£ +15
tooltips.en: Opinion: £opinion£ +15

label.en: We cannot afford that.
Goodbye.

texts.zh: 感谢你的生意。与你合作维护星系的安全，这让我们倍感骄傲。
texts.en: Thank you for your business. We are proud to work with you to make the galaxy a safer place.

label.en: So be it.

texts.zh: 是啊。对所有人来说这些都是令人忧心忡忡的时刻。我们的战略问题解决团队在创建更为安全的星系方面有着坚定不移的道德导向和毫不动摇的奉献精神。我们冒着极大的危险近距离监测新出现的危险事物，并且可以为你提供赖以行动的情报。你想要的是……
texts.en: Yes. These are concerning times for all. Our team of strategic problem solvers has a steadfast moral compass and unwavering dedication to creating a safer galaxy. We took great risks to closely monitor the emergence of new perils and can provide you with actionable intel about...

label.en: We'd like to discuss another matter.

texts.zh: 可汗的舰船总体上结构完善，没有明确弱点。我们的分析人士建议称鱼雷或许可以较好地击落他们的舰船，但要留意避免被针对防御。把护盾和装甲结合起来大概是保护你们舰船的最佳策略。可汗已然是极有能力的指挥官，低估他会是严重的错误。要把可汗的亲卫视作莫大的威胁才对。
texts.en: The Khan's ships present an overall well rounded composition, with no clear weakness. Our analysts suggest that torpedoes might perform well to take their ships down, but caution against specialized defense. A mix of both shields and armor is probably your best bet to keep your ships alive. The Khan has proven to be an extremely competent commander and underestimating them would be a terrible mistake. Consider their retinue as an extreme menace.

label.en: So be it.

texts.zh: 灰蛊风暴依赖两类互为补充的武器：能量束和舰载机。前者受护盾反制，但护盾会被舰载机绕过。我们的预测模型显示在护盾的基础上安装点防御可以大大提升舰船在交战中生还的概率。纳米舰船的防护极佳，但鱼雷或许能突破它们的防御。
texts.en: The Gray Tempest relies on two complementary weapon types: energy beams and strike craft. The former is countered by shields, but shields are bypassed by their strike craft. Our projections show that ships fitted with point defense in addition to shields have a much better chance to survive the engagement. Nanite ships are extremely well protected, but torpedoes might help in breaching their defenses.

label.en: So be it.

texts.zh: 索林原虫舰队靠着速度缓慢的动能武器和大群小型舰船打垮敌人。选项之一是用点防御御敌，结合以装甲和提升过的船体恢复力；另一个选项是远距离交战。使用足够强力的能量武器，你可以做到在敌人进入其攻击距离前就摧毁它们的舰队。
texts.en: Prethoryn fleets rely on slow moving projectiles and hosts of smaller ships to take down their foes. One option to fend them off is to use point defense, coupled with armor and improvements to your ship's hull resilience; another is to engage them at extreme range. With sufficiently powerful energy weapons, one might manage to destroy their fleets before they can even get in range.

texts.zh: 破界者单纯靠能量战斗是我们可以利用的明显弱点。能对其护盾造成额外伤害的武器都会有摧枯拉朽的效果，不过如果装上可以完全绕过护盾的武器的话，它们在这个次元同样活不了多久。就防御而言，建议在战斗中带好护盾，以充分反制敌人的能量束。
texts.en: The Unbidden's exclusive reliance on energy gives us an obvious weakness to exploit. Weapons dealing extra damage to their shields should prove devastating, but if you can fit weapons that completely bypass their shields, they won't be long for this dimension. Defensively, you should look at bringing your own shields to the fight to adequately counter their energy beams.

texts.zh: 肃正协议的舰船单纯使用能量武器——如此一来，最好用护盾降低承受的伤害。模拟结果表明尽管肃正协议舰船防御很高，但其船体相对脆弱。我们的分析人士估计称穿透性武器可能会在与肃正协议的战斗中表现出色。
texts.en: Contingency ships exclusively use energy weapons- as such, it is best to use shields to mitigate incoming damage. Simulations indicate that despite having strong defense, their ship's hulls are relatively fragile. Our analysts estimate that penetrating weapons might perform very well against them.

label.en: So be it.

texts.zh: 塞塔娜的舰船依赖于远距离、高伤害的能量武器和坚固的再生装甲。他们擅长击落大型目标，所以你最好用成群的小型飞行器骚扰他们。鱼雷或能量武器应该足以对抗她的舰队，为你的舰船装备足够的护盾可以让他们生存更长时间。
texts.en: Cetana's ships rely on long range, high damage energy weapons and sturdy regenerating armor. They are adept at taking down large targets, and you would do well to instead harass them with swarms of smaller crafts. Torpedoes or energy weapons should perform adequately against her fleets, and shielding your vessels might help them survive a little longer.

label.en: So be it.

texts.en: Looking to pacify a colony or uproot terrorists? Our planetside support services offer companies of trained professionals, ready to work in challenging and high-risk environments to help you bring order to the galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们的后勤服务能够帮助你部署舰队，到达星系的最边缘处。我们干练的专家将确保你的舰船配备了所有需要的东西，无论是弹药还是食物，甚至精确到你的温度管理器所需的铆钉。此外，我们会在舰队经过之处提前部署补给仓库，或者同当地的民用公司签订配给合同。你的舰船值得最高级的维护，而我们就是为此提供服务的。
texts.en: Our logistic support service is there to help you deploy your fleets to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. Our dedicated experts will make sure that your ships are equipped with all they need, from ammunition to food, down to the last bolt on your temperature regulators. Additionally, we will set up supply depots ahead of the fleet, or broker provisioning contracts with local civilian companies. Your ships deserve the best care, and we are here to provide it.

我们向你提供的后勤支援服务已经到期，需要续约了。根据我们合约的条款：如果我们没有另外收到相关指示，你方将自动续约这项服务，并被收取相关费用。

我们相信你对我们的服务很满意，也期待能和你在业务上展开更多的合作。
texts.en:
Dearest client,

The Logistic Support service we provide you is due for renewal. As per the terms of our contract: if we do not receive prompt instructions to do otherwise, you will be automatically billed for renewal of this service.

We trust that you are satisfied, and look forward to doing more business with you!

label.en: It's a deal!

texts.zh: 尊敬的赞助人！您今天来此有何贵干？您看过我们最新的船只设计图了吗？它们将是我们为民用客户提供的全新“个人安全”服务的核心。
texts.en: Esteemed patron! What business brings you to us today? Have you seen our latest ship schematics? They will be the core of our new 'Personal Security' offer for civilian customers.

texts.zh: 能够招待你是何等的荣幸！我们已经准备了一些小食，希望我们在召集董事会的时候，这些小食能够聊表敬意。如果你将注意力转到窗户，我会看到我们的一支维和部队正在进行演练。训练的假人代表平民。请注意他们是如何将平民召集起来，并妥善安排的。在军事上一丝不苟，实在是奇迹。
texts.en: What a pleasure to receive you! We have prepared some refreshments, should it please you to sample them while we summon the Board. If you direct your attention to the window, you'll see one of our peacekeeping divisions engaged in maneuvers. The training dummies represent civilians. Note how efficiently they round them up and handle them. A marvel of military precision.

texts.zh: 我们一直以来都很乐意同赞助人会面。请放心，下一批红利很快就会发到你的手中。你介不介意和我们聊一聊，你对于我们在严重后果保护领域展开的新业务的范围有什么看法？我们觉得民用客户肯定会爱死这些服务了！
texts.en: We are always delighted to meet our patrons. Rest assured that the next dividend shipment should reach you shortly. Would you care to tell us what you think about our range of new services in high consequence protection? We think our civilian clients will love them!

label.en: We'd like to discuss another matter.

label.zh: 我们想帮你们部署一支规模更大的舰队。
label.en: We want to help you field a bigger fleet.

label.zh: 我们想让你召回你的舰队。
label.en: We want you to recall your fleet.

label.zh: 我们乐于同你分享我们的科技。
label.en: We are inclined to share our technology with you.

texts.zh: 有了这些资金，我们可以极大地扩大我们的行动。更多的舰船，更多的人员，更加庞大、完善的训练设施……我们可以在维护和平这方面做的更多。
texts.en: With these funds, we could greatly expand our operation. More ships, more personnel, bigger and better training facilities... We would be able to do so much more to help keep the peace.

texts.zh: 在这样一个诡谲多变、纷繁复杂的星系，安全考虑是至高无上的。你的捐赠能让我们的行动和服务更上一层楼！
texts.en: In an ever-changing and complex galaxy, security concerns are paramount. Your donation would allow us to scale up our operations and services !

texts.zh: 想象一下：[mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]为了各类民事和军事行动部署在整个星系……对所有人来说，前所未有的安全感……
texts.en: Just imagine: [mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] deployed all across the galaxy for civilian and military operation... An unprecedented level of security for all...

texts.zh: 当我们开始这一切的时候，我们成立者中的一位怀揣着梦想：我们的存在是为星系带来安全，正如寰宇企业的存在是为了消灭不平等。今天，我很兴奋地宣布我们的这一目标已经触手可及。
texts.en: When we started this, one of our founders had a dream: to do for galactic security what megacorps have done for inequality. Today, I am excited to say that this goal is within our reach.

texts.zh: *我们会在整个星系部署最为庞大的舰队！资金会流动起来。平民们会安享他们应得的稳定。国家会为我们的合同大打出手……噢，当我告诉股东们新闻时，真该看看他们的脸！
texts.en: *We will field the LARGEST fleet in the galaxy! Credits will flow. Civilians will finally enjoy the stability they deserve. Nations will fight for our contracts... Oh the face of our shareholders when I tell them the news!

label.en: We'd like to discuss another matter.
It's a deal!

texts.zh:
你应该明白召回舰队是一件相当敏感的事情。当然了，我们已经在所有合同模板中准备好了条款漏洞，不过我们至少需要六个月的时间来调遣舰队回来，而且还需要支付一大笔补偿以避免惹恼现有客户。

我们认为这一行动不符合我们组织的最佳利益，但您是我们的赞助人——如果您愿意，我们愿意效劳。
texts.en:
You certainly understand that recalling a fleet is a sensitive matter. We have of course prepared the necessary loopholes in all our standard contracts, but we will need at least six months to bring the fleet back, and a... generous compensation to avoid upsetting our current customers.

We believe that this course of action is not in the best interests of our organization, but you are our patron - we'll make it happen if you wish it so.

label.en: We'd like to discuss another matter.
It's a deal!

notes.zh: 审阅注：资助者召回已出租的舰队：当前租用方立即收到“终止通知”（按城邦扩建等级分为294–299六个版本），资助者在90或180天后经隐藏事件enclave.289、再过90天收到“征用舰队抵达”（enclave.290）。
notes.en: Review note: the patron recalls a fleet already on hire: the current client immediately receives a 'Termination Notice' (six versions 294-299 by the enclave's upgrade tier); the patron receives 'Commandeered Fleet Arrives' (enclave.290) via hidden enclave.289 after 90 or 180 days plus 90 more.

texts.zh:
亲爱的客户，

依照我们的合约中第285b.15条款，我们必须遗憾地通知你，我们计划提早关闭相关服务，并收回你从我们这里租借的舰队。依照合同的惯常条例：这份通知将提前三个月送达你处作为提醒，然后我们才会让舰队停止向你提供服务。此外，我们会向你提供应得的丰厚补偿金。

我们为造成的不便感到抱歉，并希望你在未来的打拼中能够继续拥有好运气。
texts.en:
Dearest client,

As provisioned by clause 285b.15 of our contract, we must regrettably bring our arrangement to an early close and recall the Mercenary Fleet that you rented from us. As per contract stipulations: this notice serves as your 3-month warning before the fleet must leave your service. We enclose the generous compensation to which you are entitled.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.

label.en: Unfortunate.
We needed those ships!

texts.zh: 我们征用的佣兵舰队现已听候调遣。
texts.en: The Mercenary Fleet that we commandeered from our enclave is awaiting orders.

label.en: Excellent.

我们为造成的不便感到抱歉，并希望你在未来的打拼中能够继续拥有好运气。
texts.en:
Dearest client,

As provisioned by clause 285b.15 of our contract, we must regrettably bring our arrangement to an early close and recall the Mercenary Fleet that you rented from us. As per contract stipulations: this notice serves as your 3-month warning before the fleet must leave your service. We enclose the generous compensation to which you are entitled.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.

label.en: Unfortunate.
We needed those ships!

# 佣兵城邦 / Mercenary Enclave

- 分类 Category：巨兽与城邦 · DLC：霸主 Overlord
- 来源 Sources：events/overlord_enclaves_events.txt:514（enclave.200）, :561（enclave.204）, :586（enclave.205 菜单 menu）, :1009–2358（服务 services 210–285）, :2629–2794（290–299）, :3325–3619（2030–2040）; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:740; common/scripted_effects/first_contact_effects.txt:544; events/leviathans_events_1.txt:265
- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12（C6）

## 如何开始 How it starts
这是一个可重复使用的联络菜单，不是线性剧情。菜单 enclave.205 在三种情况下打开：
This is a repeatable contact menu, not a linear story. Menu enclave.205 opens:
- 首次接触完成或“通讯已建立”之后（enclave.204）；After first contact completes or 'Communications Established' (enclave.204);
- 之后每次向城邦发起外交联络（enclave.200，on_custom_diplomacy）；On every later diplomatic contact (enclave.200);
- 玩家亲手建立佣兵城邦时（见“佣兵城邦基金会”）。Right after the player founds one (see "Mercenary Enclave Foundation").

## 剧情脉络 Story outline（菜单与服务 Menu and services）
每项服务窗口都可“讨论别的事”返回菜单（图中 ↺）。Every service window can return to the menu (↺ in the map).
- 租用舰队 Rent a fleet（210 → 211 致谢）：租期10年，附带佣兵指挥官。到期见独立故事“舰队合约到期”。10-year lease with a mercenary commander; expiry is the separate story "Fleet Contract Ended".
- 管理租用舰队 Manage the fleet（215）：续约或解约。Extend or terminate.
- 佣兵驻军 Garrisons（220 → 225）：信任≥30可见、≥40可买；购买恒星基地建筑许可。
- 战术评估 Tactical appraisal（240 → 245–266）：仅在与天灾或强敌有通讯时出现，分别介绍大可汗、灰色风暴、索林原虫、异次元入侵者、肃正协议、塞塔娜；首次付费，之后免费重看。Only when a crisis/great foe is in contact; first reading is paid, later ones free.
- 雇佣地面部队 Ground troops（270）：五种规模/机械化部队。
- 后勤支援 Logistic support（2030）：按海军容量收费；3600天后“后勤支援合约即将到期”（2035）询问续费。Renewal notice 2035 after 3600 days.
- 资助者事务 Patron panel（280，仅资助者可见 patron only）：扩充城邦舰队（235，五级）、召回已出租舰队（285）、共享科技（2040，每10年一次）。
  - 召回 Recall（285）：当前租用方立即收到“终止通知”（294–299，按城邦等级六个版本，3个月预告并退款）；资助者在90或180天后再加90天收到“征用舰队抵达”（290）。The current client gets a Termination Notice at once; the patron gets "Commandeered Fleet Arrives" after 90/180 + 90 days.
- 敌对时：只显示“支付2500能量和解”。While hostile: only a 2500-energy truce.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes
菜单本身没有结局；城邦被毁见“佣兵城邦被摧毁”。若城邦遭攻击，租用方收到“舰队紧急召回”。相关一次性故事：“不应拒绝的交易”（大可汗）。
The menu has no ending; destruction is the separate story "Mercenary Enclave Destroyed"; an attack on the enclave triggers "Emergency Fleet Recall"; see also "A Deal We Should Not Refuse".

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants
多数服务受信任度门槛（10–50）、冷却与已购买标记限制；游牧帝国不可买驻军，生物舰船帝国以食物替代能量支付扩建。
Most services require trust thresholds (10-50), cooldowns or not-yet-bought flags; nomads cannot buy garrisons; bio-ship empires pay food instead of energy for upgrades.

## 审阅记录 Review notes
- 已逐项核对 205 的全部选项、各服务窗口的选项与后续调用、290–299 的接收者。Checked every 205 option, each service's options and follow-ups, recipients of 290–299.
- 更正：草稿中同一菜单出现在五个故事（200、204、建立、可汗交易、合约到期）里；现合并为本故事族，其他故事改为跨故事链接。
  Correction: the draft copied this menu into five stories; it is now one family and the others cross-link to it.
- 覆盖完整。Coverage complete.
